test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: Using the method of semi-average, secular trend is measured when:

options.text: times series comprises even number of values
trend is symmetric about the mean
time series is based on annual values

solution:
The method of semi-average is used to measure linear secular trend. It involves dividing the time period into two equal parts, calculating the

average value of the variable for each part, and then subtracting one average from the other. The difference between the two averages

represents the linear secular trend, as it measures the rate of change in the variable over time.
